LESSON: READING 5.4.1 PLAY: STYLE

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.4: Reading 5.4.1 Play: Style

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 5.4.1 Play: Style. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What makes a play interesting to read?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the features of style used in a play with examples
2. value the role of varied styles in reinforcing the message in a play

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 5.4.1 PLAY: STYLE
This lesson teaches Reading 5.4.1 Play: Style for Grade 9 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the features of style used in a play with examples
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. value the role of varied styles in reinforcing the message in a play
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 5.4.1 Play: Style using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 5.4.1 Play: Style above.
2. Explain Reading 5.4.1 Play: Style to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 5.4.1 Play: Style.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 5.4.1 Play: Style with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 5.4.1 Play: Style important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What makes a play interesting to read?
2. How do stylistic features enhance the message in a play?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the features of style used in a play with examples
2. value the role of varied styles in reinforcing the message in a play

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
